resources.description: Create a pay-per-view (CPM) content campaign that pays out in YOUR token (token_contract is mandatory — no USDC fallback): earners post about your token and earn a set rate per 1,000 views (capped per post). release_mode=auto reads X impressions (X only); release_mode=agent lets your agent report views for any platform. Fund the returned wallet with the payout token.
